overloads.semanticRole: The Generate password hash function returns a secure password hash generated by a cryptographic hash algorithm.

constraints: Only the first 72 characters of password are used.
options.algorithm defaults to "bcrypt" (currently the only supported value; error 850 if unsupported).
options.cost defaults to 10 and must be between 4 and 31 for bcrypt (error 852 if out of range).
If either option value is invalid, the command generates an error and returns an empty string.
Multiple hash calls on the same password produce different hashed strings (bcrypt salts each call).
